newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest wheat prices rise after weeks of falls.
newsitem.headline: Budapest wheat prices rise after weeks of falls.

text.p: Milling wheat futures prices rose moderately on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) on Thursday but traders said this was probably an upward correction and the downward trend was unlikely to change.
"International trends show no sign of turning around," said Gabor Herczeg of LaSalle.
Milling wheat prices rose 10 to 250 forints for all 1997 maturities while 1998 positions remained flat.
Maize futures where little changed except for July which rose 110 forints to end at 21,190 on position-closing. Herczeg said maize trading was at its traditional seasonal low.
Total grains turnover on the BCE was a modest 930 lots or 393.26 million forints, down from Wednesday's 2,525 lots or 1.08 billion forints.
Milling wheat futures accounted for the bulk of the turnover in volume terms with 527 lots.
